assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology enabled a major therapeutic advance in diabetes and obesity with wide medical impact.
assessment.attribution: Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker represent central physiological, molecular, and translational contributions.
assessment.maturity: The biological mechanism and therapeutic benefit have been extensively established over decades.
uncertainties: Attribution for drug-development contributions extends beyond three people.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: TNF blockade transformed treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and established a broadly influential therapeutic principle for inflammatory disease.
assessment.attribution: Feldmann and Maini form a clear, compact pairing for the mechanistic and clinical translation.
assessment.maturity: Long-term clinical use across inflammatory disorders provides exceptional confirmation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Modern cochlear implants restored meaningful hearing and speech access for large numbers of people through a decisive medical-engineering advance.
assessment.attribution: Clark and Hochmair were pivotal in implant development, while Wilson made a defining contribution to speech-processing strategies.
assessment.maturity: Durable clinical success and successive technical validation make the contribution highly mature.
uncertainties: The field includes substantial additional engineering and clinical contributions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BCR-ABL inhibition made chronic myeloid leukemia a landmark example of effective molecularly targeted cancer treatment.
assessment.attribution: Lydon, Druker, and Sawyers capture key drug-discovery, clinical-development, and disease-mechanism contributions.
assessment.maturity: The therapeutic principle has sustained clinical validation and broad influence on oncology.
uncertainties: Credit for the underlying BCR-ABL disease biology is distributed more widely.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: HPV virus-like-particle vaccines provide a powerful preventive route against infection and cervical and other HPV-related cancers.
assessment.attribution: Lowy, Schiller, and Frazer are strongly associated with the key vaccine-enabling work.
assessment.maturity: Population-scale deployment and sustained effectiveness support mature recognition.
uncertainties: The eventual extent of cancer prevention varies with vaccination coverage and follow-up duration.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Orexin biology supplied a fundamental physiological account of stable wakefulness and a mechanistic understanding of narcolepsy.
assessment.attribution: Yanagisawa and de Lecea led the independent discovery of the peptide system, while Mignot made decisive links to narcolepsy.
assessment.maturity: The pathway's physiological role, disease relevance, and pharmacological importance are well established.
uncertainties: There are competing valid choices among contributors to discovery and disease attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: CFTR modulation converted a mechanistic understanding of cystic fibrosis into therapies that alter disease course.
assessment.attribution: Welsh provided foundational CFTR functional insight, and Van Goor and Negulescu were central to modulator development.
assessment.maturity: Clinical benefits are robust, although access and genotype-specific response remain important limitations.
uncertainties: The contribution overlaps conceptually with the separate discovery of the CFTR gene.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: CAR-T therapy established genetically engineered immune cells as a potent treatment modality for otherwise refractory cancers.
assessment.attribution: June, Sadelain, and Rosenberg each made major, complementary contributions to adoptive cell therapy and CAR-T development.
assessment.maturity: Clinical efficacy is compelling and the platform has been validated across hematologic malignancies.
uncertainties: Durability, toxicity, access, and extension to solid tumors remain unresolved.
